_README: Allowlist for check-demo-seed-coverage.mjs. "exempt": tables with no demo rows on purpose, each with its reason. "notYetSeeded": a BURN-DOWN list of tables the demo seed does not fill yet, as of 2026-10-17. It only shrinks: seed the table in ctf/scripts/demo-seed/ and delete its line. Never add a new table to it; a new table is seeded, or exempt with a reason.
